page_title: ARS 2-2 TOT | Arsenal v Tottenham Hotspur 24/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's the end of the match.
90+11' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
90+10' What a chance for Richarlison (Tottenham) as he produced a stunning snap shot from the edge of the box! The goalkeeper was a bit lucky as the ball went just wide of the right post.
90+9' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
90+9' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) makes a rough challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.
90+7' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Emile Smith Rowe (Arsenal) will replace Bukayo Saka.
90+6' Richarlison (Tottenham) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
90+4' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
90+3' Richarlison (Tottenham) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
90+3' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
90+2' Reiss Nelson (Arsenal) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

90+2' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but the keeper dives and denies him. The referee points to the corner flag and Arsenal will take a corner.
90+1' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) whips in a cross from the corner, but Guglielmo Vicario is well positioned and punches the ball away.
90' The fourth official shows 10 min. of added time.
89' Reiss Nelson (Arsenal) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
88' Reiss Nelson (Arsenal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
87' The ball rebounds out to Kai Havertz (Arsenal) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
86' Jorginho (Arsenal) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
85' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
85' Reiss Nelson (Arsenal) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.

82' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) tries to find Eddie Nketiah, but he puts too much power on the pass.

79' Here's the change. Heung-Min Son leaves the pitch and Richarlison (Tottenham) comes on as a substitute.
78' Here is a change. James Maddison is going off and Ange Postecoglou gives the last tactical orders to Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham).
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Reiss Nelson (Arsenal) is coming onto the pitch as Gabriel Jesus cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
76' Ben White (Arsenal) sends a cross into the box, but Guglielmo Vicario comes off his line to gather the ball.
76' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Robert Jones blows his whistle for a foul.

73' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

72' James Maddison (Tottenham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
71' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to David Raya, who smothers the ball.
71' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
69' James Maddison (Tottenham) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
69' What a big chance! Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
69' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Arsenal.
67' Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) is penalised.
67' James Maddison (Tottenham) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
66' Gabriel (Arsenal) brings his opponent down. Robert Jones has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
63' Brennan Johnson is being substituted because of an injury. Ange Postecoglou sends Manor Solomon (Tottenham) on the pitch.
61' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
61' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Ben White.
57' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kai Havertz (Arsenal) was quite harsh and Robert Jones didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
55' 2 - 2 Goal - 2:2! James Maddison tees up Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past David Raya.
54' 2 - 1 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) high into the middle of the goal, giving goalkeeper Guglielmo Vicario no chance!
53' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
53' Referee Robert Jones awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

51' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Arsenal.
50' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
49' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
49' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) swings it in and James Maddison gets on the end of it, but David Raya shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.

31' The corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is cleared away by the defence.
31' The resulting corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is cleared by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play. Arsenal win a corner kick.
31' A cross into the box from Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) is cleared.
30' Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
29' Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
26' 1 - 0 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham), who attempted to smack the ball away, but instead he sends it inside the right post of his own goal.
25' The free kick is delivered by James Maddison (Tottenham) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.

24' Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.

19' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
19' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) serves up a nice cross, but David Raya punches the ball away.
17' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) is penalised for holding. Robert Jones signals a set piece.
17' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

16' Guglielmo Vicario makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Eddie Nketiah (Arsenal) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the right side of the target.
15' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
15' Robert Jones shows a yellow card to Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) for his blatant foul.
14' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot towards the top of the goal that is easily dealt with by Guglielmo Vicario.
